🤖 Follow-up to Wes’s final review ([review](https://github.com/block/buzz-app/pull/595#pullrequestreview-5419846439)) at pushed head `8a583c54`:

- **Legacy denial:** fixed in `d4dcfa69` and subsequent cancellation refinements. Legacy **Cancel** sends bounded best-effort `user_denied` before payload publication, then terminates the attempt; owner/UI regression tests cover the path. Replied in the [original thread](https://github.com/block/buzz-app/pull/595#discussion_r4186847790).
- **Connection timeout:** fixed in `d4dcfa69`. Connection establishment has a 10-second bound, and setup has a separate 35-second bound; failure surfaces **Try again** instead of auto-renewing an expired QR. Replied in the [original thread](https://github.com/block/buzz-app/pull/595#discussion_r4187112446).
- **Mobile import acknowledgement:** the import-ack repair is separate `block/buzz` work, not part of desktop PR #595. Replied in the [original thread](https://github.com/block/buzz-app/pull/595#discussion_r4187112720).

The separate Clippy-only context grouping in `8a583c54` passed the required push checks and full native package (303 passed, 7 ignored). Kalvin reports **live testing of the new code-entry flow succeeded**: typing the desktop code on the phone automatically paired it, with no desktop “Codes match” click. This is human acceptance evidence for that flow.

  • Connection timeout: fixed in d4dcfa69. Connection establishment has a 10-second bound, and setup has a separate 35-second bound; failure surfaces Try again instead of auto-renewing an expired QR. Replied in the original thread.
  • Mobile import acknowledgement: the import-ack repair is separate block/buzz work, not part of desktop PR #595. Replied in the original thread.

🤖 Follow-up to the latest reviews, pushed at `0b1f159d`:

- **Import acknowledgement wording ([review](https://github.com/block/buzz-app/pull/595#pullrequestreview-5432737162)):** the desktop no longer guarantees durable import. The finish step now reads "Your account was sent. Check that it's signed in on your phone." `docs/pairing.md` item 5 now says **Phone paired** means the phone acknowledged the transfer. It notes that current phones can acknowledge before saving, asks the user to verify on the phone, and says the mobile fix is separate `block/buzz` work, outside this PR.
- **Cancellation outcome (P2, [review](https://github.com/block/buzz-app/pull/595#pullrequestreview-5432820023)):** fixed in the native owner, client, and UI, with regressions. Details are in the [inline thread](https://github.com/block/buzz-app/pull/595#discussion_r4198939856).
- **Screen-observer note:** documented. Details are in the [inline thread](https://github.com/block/buzz-app/pull/595#discussion_r4198939864).
